name: What are common signs of a gas leak from a pool heater?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs of a gas leak from a pool heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a gas leak from a pool heater include a distinct sulfur or rotten egg smell, which is an additive to natural gas to make leaks detectable. You might also notice a hissing sound near the heater, unexplained dead or discolored vegetation around the gas line, or an increase in your gas bill without a change in usage. If you suspect a gas leak, it's important to turn off the gas supply and contact a professional immediately to ensure safety and prevent further issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs of a gas leak include a rotten egg smell, hissing sounds, discolored vegetation, or an unexplained increase in your gas bill.
